That being said, I think the right to be forgotten is a good temporary measure for a few decades, even though it's a great restriction of freedom. The world is becoming connected and transparent and the society is getting used to it. Hopefully, eventually people will learn not to judge others based on incomplete information about something that happened years ago. Maybe people will even learn to not think of anyone as a "good person" or a "bad person", but instead judge each aspect of their character separately. Until this process is complete, the right to be forgotten is useful, once it is, this right will become unnecessary.
